content.title: Athletics - Montverde Academy
content.text: Skip To Main Content Search Clear Search Close Close Menu Search Clear Search 12 Athletics Our athletics programs have earned notable distinctions that include 21 national championship titles, 12 state titles and more than 100 student-athletes that have gone on to play professionally. We have varsity sports for 21 teams and sports academies for Boys Basketball, Boys Soccer, as well as Boys and Girls Tennis. Many Montverde Academy sports programs compete in the Florida High School Athletic Association state series, while its nationally renowned Boys Basketball program competes in the NIKE EYBL Scholastic Conference.
